High-Performance Positive Displacement Gear Pump

You need a trustworthy positive displacement gear pump which can handle both viscous and delicate fluids. Rotozest Industries operates as a dependable manufacturer and exporter of high-quality gear pumps, which deliver efficient performance and durable construction, while maintaining consistent flow rates across various industrial applications.

Our company develops gear pumps through advanced technological methods which enable accurate fluid transfer operations for applications that require exactness and operational dependability.

What is a Positive Displacement Gear Pump?

A positive displacement gear pump operates by sealing a constant volume of liquid between its spinning gears which then delivers the liquid to its discharge point. The system maintains consistent flow rates which remain unbroken through different pressure conditions.

The pumps find extensive application for processing:

Viscous liquids
Oils and lubricants
Chemicals
Food-grade materials

Our Product Range

SS Rotary Gear Pump Manufacturer

Rotozest Industries operates as the top manufacturer of SS rotary gear pumps by producing stainless steel pumps which serve hygienic and corrosion-resistant use cases.

Key Features:

  • Made from high-grade stainless steel
  • Corrosion and rust resistant
  • Suitable for food, pharma, and chemical industries
  • Easy to clean and maintain
  • Long service life

CI Rotary Gear Pump

The CI rotary gear pump uses cast iron materials for its construction which makes it suitable for industrial applications that require heavy-duty performance.

Key Features:

  • Strong and robust design,
  • Ideal for oil, fuel, and industrial fluids,
  • Cost-effective solution,
  • High efficiency under tough conditions,
  • Low maintenance

Key Benefits of Our Gear Pumps

  • Consistent Flow Rate:
    The system provides constant output which remains unchanged despite fluctuations in pressure.
  • Handles High Viscosity Fluids:
    The system operates effectively with both thick liquids and semi-solid materials.
  • Energy Efficient:
    The system achieves lower energy usage through its optimized design.
  • Leak-Proof Operation:
    The system provides secure and sanitary fluid movement.
  • Versatile Applications:
    The system functions effectively across different industrial sectors.

Applications

Technical Highlights

FAQs

faq.q: What is the advantage of a positive displacement gear pump?
faq.a: It provides a constant flow rate and handles high-viscosity fluids efficiently.

faq.q: Which industries use SS rotary gear pumps?
faq.a: They are mainly used in food processing, pharmaceuticals, and chemical industries due to their hygienic properties.

faq.q: What is the difference between SS and CI gear pumps?
faq.a: SS pumps offer corrosion resistance and hygiene, while CI pumps are more economical and suitable for heavy-duty industrial use.

faq.q: Can gear pumps handle thick liquids?
faq.a: Yes, they are specifically designed to handle viscous and semi-solid fluids.

faq.q: Does Rotozest Industries provide customized solutions?
faq.a: Yes, we offer tailored gear pump solutions based on your application needs.
